batch.description: Rows: one token each (sparse) or one request each (dense).

page_size.description: Slots per page of the KV pool.

n_extra_pages.description: Pages of the extra KV pool.

extra_page_size.description: Slots per page of the extra KV pool.

table_width.description: Columns of the 2-D block_table, or length of the flat one.

kv_dim.description: Bytes (sparse) or values (dense) per pool slot.

q.description: The queries of each row; dense: the rope part last.

kv_cache.description: The KV pool: packed dsv4 slots of 584 bytes, 576-byte payloads then 8-byte scales. sglang's DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool pads each page to ceil_div(page_size * 584, 576) * 576 bytes.

sparse_indices.description: Slots of the KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

sparse_lens.description: Leading sparse_indices each token reads; all when absent.

extra_kv_cache.description: The extra KV pool, packed dsv4 slots in pages padded as kv_cache's.

extra_sparse_indices.description: Slots of the extra KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

extra_sparse_lens.description: Leading extra_sparse_indices each token reads; all when absent.

block_table.description: Pool rows of each request: a (batch, width) table read up to cache_seqlens, or every request's rows back to back.

cache_seqlens.description: Leading block_table entries each request reads, at least one.

cu_seqlens_k.description: Where each request's rows start in block_table, then its length.

causal.description: Whether query i of a request of length L reads only its first L - query_length + i + 1 rows.

sm_scale.description: Multiplies every logit; q.shape[-1] ** -0.5 when absent.

sinks.description: Per-head logit added to the normalisation only, not to lse.

kv_cache_format.description: The pool rows: DeepSeek-V4's packed fp8 slots (sparse), or 576 fp8 or bf16 values (dense).

kv_scale.description: Multiplies every KV value, in the logits and the values.

output.description: Softmax-weighted sum of the read values; 0 for no row read.

lse.description: Log-sum-exp of the scaled logits, sinks excluded; for no row read +inf (sparse) or -inf (dense).

description: MLA attention over a paged KV pool, FlashMLA's API. Sparse: each token attends to the slots its indices name, in the pool and the optional extra one; sinks join the normalisation only. Dense: each request attends to its context rows; q's rope part is last, scores are q . row * sm_scale * kv_scale and values row[:head_dim_v] * kv_scale. With causal, query i of a request of length L reads its first L - query_length + i + 1 rows.
constraints: extra_kv_cache is not None or extra_sparse_lens is None
extra_kv_cache is None or extra_kv_cache.dtype in ('uint8', 'float8_e4m3fn')
extra_kv_cache is None or n_extra_pages * extra_page_size <= 2147483648

"""DeepSeek-V4 sparse MLA decode (flash_mla_with_kvcache, dsv4 fp8, padded pages, a window pool and an extra pool,
sinks, LSE) for MI355X in FlyDSL, C128 layers: two kernels by the number of (request, 64-head) groups - few.py up
to 8 groups (latency: every CU on a few requests), many.py from 16 (throughput). Each is correct at any batch; the
split is by speed."""
from . import few, many

FEW_GROUPS = 8


def run(
    q,
    kv_cache,
    sparse_indices,
    sparse_lens,
    extra_kv_cache,
    extra_sparse_indices,
    extra_sparse_lens,
    block_table,
    cache_seqlens,
    cu_seqlens_k,
    causal,
    sm_scale,
    sinks,
    kv_cache_format,
    kv_scale,
    output,
    lse,
):
    """The AKLR entry: see few.run / many.run."""
    head_dim_v = None
    sm_scale = q.shape[-1] ** -0.5 if sm_scale is None else sm_scale
    return_lse = True
    impl = few if q.shape[0] * q.shape[2] // 64 <= FEW_GROUPS else many
    return impl.run(q=q, kv_cache=kv_cache, sparse_indices=sparse_indices, sparse_lens=sparse_lens,
                    extra_kv_cache=extra_kv_cache, extra_sparse_indices=extra_sparse_indices,
                    extra_sparse_lens=extra_sparse_lens, block_table=block_table, cache_seqlens=cache_seqlens,
                    cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens_k, causal=causal, head_dim_v=512 if head_dim_v is None else head_dim_v,
                    sm_scale=sm_scale, sinks=sinks, kv_cache_format=kv_cache_format, kv_scale=kv_scale,
                    return_lse=return_lse, output=output, lse=lse)

"""DeepSeek-V4-Pro sparse MLA decode (C128 layers, dsv4_fp8 padded pages) for gfx950 in FlyDSL.

Two launches on the caller's stream:

attn_kernel (256 workgroups x 512 threads, one a CU): the key lists of all (request, 64-head group) pairs, each cut into
32-key tiles and preceded by VSEG virtual tiles (the cost of starting a segment), are concatenated and split evenly
over the workgroups. A workgroup's share is a few segments (one per group it touches), processed as one stream of
tiles in a software pipeline (rows gathered two tiles ahead, dequantized into an f16 K tile in LDS one tile ahead,
three K buffers). Waves:
  S-waves 0-3 (16 heads each): S^T = K Q^T with 16x16x32 f16 MFMAs (Q in registers), online softmax in the log2
    domain with a lazy rescale (only when a score passes the running max by 8), P as f16 to LDS; they also gather
    and dequantize 3 of the tile's 28 x 32 16-byte code chunks a lane.
  PV-waves 4-7 (32 heads x 256 dims each), one tile behind: O += P V with 32x32x16 f16 MFMAs (V read transposed by
    ds_read_b64_tr_b16); they gather the RoPE dims and the remaining code chunks, and wave 7 also turns the next
    tiles' indices into row addresses (a ring in LDS, 4 tiles ahead) and the key mask.
  A segment's partial (O / l in f16, m, l) goes to slot (workgroup + group) of the scratch.
combine_kernel (a wave a (request, head)): merges a group's partials with the attention sink: out (bf16) and lse.
The workgroups of a launch never wait for each other; partials cross only the kernel boundary.

Numerics: K / V rows are dequantized by the hardware e4m3 -> f16 conversion with the group's scale (the spec's e = 0
codes, 2^-7 (1 + m/8), made exact by converting with every exponent + 1 and half the scale whenever the group has no
code >= 0x77); Q and P are f16, accumulation f32. Exact for group scales 2^-13 .. 2^7 (scale bytes 114 .. 134: every
code an f16 normal); smaller scales lose precision only on codes below 2^-14 (f16 subnormals), larger ones overflow.
"""
import functools
import math

import torch

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
from flydsl.expr import rocdl, range_constexpr, const_expr

A = fx.arith                    # MLIR types (public re-export)
LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
LN2 = 0.6931471805599453
D = 512                         # head dim (nope 448 + rope 64)
ROWB = 576                      # data bytes of a pool row
TILE = 32                       # keys a tile
NTHR = 512
NWG = 256                       # workgroups of the attention launch
KBUF = TILE * 1024              # f16 K tile bytes (32 rows x 512 x 2 B)
PROW = 80                       # bytes of a P row in LDS (32 keys f16 + pad)
PSLOT = 64 * PROW               # a P buffer (64 heads)
CRW = 4                         # combine: rows (waves) a block
RING = 8                        # tiles of row addresses in flight
GMAX = 256                      # groups (request x 64 heads) and requests at most
NSLOT = NWG + GMAX              # partial slots (workgroup + group) a head
VSEG = 6                        # tiles a segment start costs, for the split
TMAX = 320                      # tiles a workgroup at most
GS = 4                          # S-wave K reads a group (the next group's go out before its MFMAs)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- low-level helpers

def i32t():
    return A.IntegerType.get_signless(32)


def vty(n, et):
    return A.VectorType.get([n], et)


def aligned(p, align):
    """p as a pointer known to be align-byte aligned (keeps 16-byte accesses single instructions)"""
    et = p.element_type
    return fx.recast_iter(fx.PointerType.get(et if isinstance(et, A.Type) else et.ir_type, p.memspace, align), p)


def ldv(p, n, et, align=16):
    return fx.ptr_load(aligned(p, align), vty(n, et) if n > 1 else et)


def stv(p, v, align=16):
    fx.ptr_store(v if isinstance(v, A.Value) else v.ir_value(), aligned(p, align))


def gload(c, addr, n, et, align):
    """a load from a raw global address (Int64)"""
    p = fx.inttoptr(fx.PointerType.get(et, c.gspace, align), fx.Int64(addr).ir_value())
    return fx.ptr_load(p, vty(n, et) if n > 1 else et)


SC1 = 16                        # cache policy sc1: the store is written through to memory


def wt_store(rsrc, elem_off, v, esize):
    """a partial's store (element offset into its buffer), written through: the kernel's end then has no L2
    writeback of the partials to wait for"""
    rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(v.ir_value(), rsrc, fx.Int32(elem_off * esize).ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                               aux=A.IntegerAttr.get(i32t(), SC1))


def addr_of(t):
    return fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(fx.get_iter(t)))


def vec(v, n, dt):
    return fx.Vector(v, (n,), dt)


def fmax(a, b):
    return fx.maxnumf(a, b)


def exp2(x):
    return fx.Float32(rocdl.exp2(A.F32Type.get(), fx.Float32(x).ir_value()))


def swz(row):
    """16-byte chunk swizzle of a K tile row: conflict-free K reads and 32x32 V transpose reads"""
    return ((row & 3) << 2) | ((row >> 2) & 3)


def grp_max(x):
    """max over the 4 lanes l % 16 (one head's 16x16 C fragment rows)"""
    y = fmax(x, fx.Float32(fx.gpu.shuffle_xor(x, 16, 64)))
    return fmax(y, fx.Float32(fx.gpu.shuffle_xor(y, 32, 64)))


def grp_sum(x):
    y = x + fx.Float32(fx.gpu.shuffle_xor(x, 16, 64))
    return y + fx.Float32(fx.gpu.shuffle_xor(y, 32, 64))


def wave_excl_scan(x):
    """exclusive prefix sum of an Int32 over the 64 lanes, and the total (DPP: no LDS round trips)"""
    inc = x
    for ctrl in (0x111, 0x112, 0x114, 0x118):       # row_shr 1, 2, 4, 8 (zero past the row's start)
        inc = inc + fx.Int32(rocdl.update_dpp(i32t(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), inc.ir_value(), ctrl, 0xF, 0xF, True))
    for ctrl, rmask in ((0x142, 0xA), (0x143, 0xC)):  # row_bcast 15 / 31 into the following rows
        inc = inc + fx.Int32(rocdl.update_dpp(i32t(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(), inc.ir_value(), ctrl, rmask, 0xF,
                                              False))
    tot = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(i32t(), inc.ir_value(), fx.Int32(63).ir_value()))
    return inc - x, tot


class Ctx:
    """per-wave constants handed to the step helpers"""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- row-address ring (PV-wave 7, lanes 0-31)

def tile_info(c, tile):
    """the tile table entry: (group, first key, keys, first, last, slot, window length of the request, request)"""
    lo = vec(ldv(c.tabp + tile * 8, 4, i32t()), 4, fx.Int32)
    hi = vec(ldv(c.tabp + (tile * 8 + 4), 4, i32t()), 4, fx.Int32)
    return lo, hi


def prod_load(c, tile, lane):
    """issue the index load of key lane of tile; -> (index, flags)"""
    lo, hi = tile_info(c, tile)
    key = lo[1] + lane
    ok = lane < lo[2]
    swl = hi[2]
    b = hi[3]
    is_sw = key < swl
    ks = fx.max(fx.min(key, c.SWW - 1), 0)
    kk = fx.max(fx.min(key - swl, c.KVW - 1), 0)
    off = is_sw.select(fx.Int64(b * c.SWW + ks), fx.Int64(b * c.KVW + kk))
    base = is_sw.select(c.swi_b, c.kvi_b)
    idx = fx.Int32(gload(c, base + off * 4, 1, i32t(), 4))
    flags = ok.select(is_sw.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(3)), fx.Int32(0))     # bit 0 valid key, bit 1 kv pool
    return idx, flags


def prod_store(c, tile, idx, flags, lane):
    """the ring entry of key lane of tile: (row address lo, hi, scale bytes - row address, valid), and its mask"""
    valid = ((flags & 1) != 0) & (idx >= 0)
    is_kv = (flags & 2) != 0
    slot = fx.max(idx, 0)
    r_s = slot % c.RS
    r_k = slot % c.RK
    d_s = fx.Int64(slot // c.RS) * c.PBS + fx.Int64(r_s * ROWB)
    d_k = fx.Int64(slot // c.RK) * c.PBK + fx.Int64(r_k * ROWB)
    a = is_kv.select(c.kv_b + d_k, c.swa_b + d_s)
    a = valid.select(a, c.zero_b)
    sd = valid.select(is_kv.select((c.RK - r_k) * ROWB + r_k * 8, (c.RS - r_s) * ROWB + r_s * 8), fx.Int32(ROWB))
    ent = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Int32(a), fx.Int32(a >> 32), sd, valid.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))],
                                  fx.Int32)
    rs = tile % RING
    stv(c.ringp + (lane < TILE).select((rs * TILE + lane) * 4, RING * TILE * 4 + lane * 4), ent)
    (c.maskp + (lane < TILE).select(rs * TILE + lane, RING * TILE + lane)).store(
        valid.select(fx.Float32(0.0), fx.Float32(-math.inf)).bitcast(fx.Int32))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- row gathering / dequantization

def chunk_kp(q):
    """code chunk q (0 .. 895) of the tile -> (key, 16-byte part 0 .. 27): an 8-lane write phase covers keys k, k + 4
    (swizzles differing in bit 0) x 4 parts, so the 8 lanes' 16-byte LDS stores hit 8 distinct bank groups"""
    blk = q // 224
    w = q % 224
    g = w // 8
    return blk * 8 + g % 4 + ((w // 4) % 2) * 4, (g // 4) * 4 + w % 4


def chunk_setup_s(c, tid):
    """S-wave lane: code chunks 256 r + tid, r = 0, 1, 2"""
    c.rk, c.rpart = [], []
    for r in range_constexpr(3):
        k, pp = chunk_kp(tid + 256 * r)
        c.rk.append(k)
        c.rpart.append(pp)


def chunk_setup_pv(c, ptid):
    """PV-wave lane: RoPE chunk ptid; code chunk 768 + ptid (waves 4, 5; waves 6, 7 store theirs to a dummy)"""
    k, pp = chunk_kp(fx.min(ptid + 768, 895))
    c.rk = [ptid // 8, k]
    c.rpart = [ptid % 8, pp]
    c.code_ok = ptid < 128


def ring_entry(c, tt, key):
    return vec(ldv(c.ringp + ((tt % RING) * TILE + key) * 4, 4, i32t()), 4, fx.Int32)


def row_addr(e):
    return (fx.Int64(e[1]) << 32) | (fx.Int64(e[0]) & fx.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF))


def load_code(c, tt, r):
    e = ring_entry(c, tt, c.rk[r])
    a = row_addr(e)
    part = c.rpart[r]
    d = vec(gload(c, a + fx.Int64(part * 16), 4, i32t(), 16), 4, fx.Int32)
    s = fx.Int32(gload(c, a + fx.Int64(e[2] + (part // 16) * 4), 1, i32t(), 4))
    return [d, s, e[3]]


def load_rope(c, tt, r):
    e = ring_entry(c, tt, c.rk[r])
    d = vec(gload(c, row_addr(e) + fx.Int64(448 + c.rpart[r] * 16), 4, i32t(), 16), 4, fx.Int32)
    return [d]


def store_code(c, buf, r, ld, dst_ok=None):
    """16 codes -> f16 into the K tile: the hardware conversion with the group's scale 2^(c - 127). The spec's e = 0
    codes are normals 2^-7 (1 + m/8): every exponent + 1 and half the scale makes them IEEE normals - unless a code of
    the group is >= 0x77 in magnitude (it would become NaN; then the e = 0 ones are 2^-14 of the group's top)"""
    data, scw, valid = ld
    key = c.rk[r]
    part = c.rpart[r]
    sc = (scw >> (((part // 4) & 3) * 8)) & 255
    u = [(data[i] & fx.Int32(0x7F7F7F7F)) + fx.Int32(0x09090909) for i in range(4)]
    big = ((u[0] | u[1] | u[2] | u[3]) & fx.Int32(-2139062144)) != 0     # 0x80808080: a byte's magnitude >= 0x77
    add = big.select(fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(0x08080808))
    scf = ((sc - big.select(fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(1))) << 23).bitcast(fx.Float32)
    v2 = vty(2, A.F16Type.get())
    dq = []
    for i in range_constexpr(4):
        xi = data[i] + add
        for hi in (False, True):
            cv = rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_f16_fp8(v2, xi.ir_value(), scf.ir_value(), hi)
            dq.append(vec(cv, 2, fx.Float16).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0])
    sw = swz(key)
    rowo = buf * (KBUF // 4) + key * 256
    o0 = rowo + ((part * 2) ^ sw) * 4
    o1 = rowo + ((part * 2 + 1) ^ sw) * 4
    if dst_ok is not None:
        o0 = dst_ok.select(o0, 3 * (KBUF // 4) + c.lane * 4)
        o1 = dst_ok.select(o1, 3 * (KBUF // 4) + c.lane * 4)
    stv(c.kt + o0, fx.Vector.from_elements(dq[0:4], fx.Int32))
    stv(c.kt + o1, fx.Vector.from_elements(dq[4:8], fx.Int32))


def store_rope(c, buf, r, ld):
    key = c.rk[r]
    d = ld[0].bitcast(fx.BFloat16).to(fx.Float32).to(fx.Float16).bitcast(fx.Int32)
    stv(c.kt + (buf * (KBUF // 4) + key * 256 + ((c.rpart[r] + 56) ^ swz(key)) * 4), d)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the two roles' steps

def s_step_a(c, s, t, ld_cur, qv, m_ref):
    """S-wave step t, part 1: loads of tile t + 2, S(t) (+ dequantize tile t + 1 from ld_cur), scaled scores"""
    ldn = []
    for r in range_constexpr(3):
        ldn.extend(load_code(c, t + 2, r))
    kbase = c.kt + (t % 3) * (KBUF // 4)
    nb1 = (t + 1) % 3
    f16t = A.F16Type.get()
    f32 = A.F32Type.get()
    acc_ty = vty(4, f32)
    reads = []
    for kb in range_constexpr(2):
        for st in range_constexpr(16):
            reads.append(kbase + (s.koff[st % 4] + kb * 4096 + (st // 4) * 64))
    av = [None] * 32
    for i in range_constexpr(GS):
        av[i] = vec(ldv(reads[i], 8, f16t), 8, fx.Float16)
    sacc = []
    acc = s.zero4
    for gi in range_constexpr(32 // GS):
        if gi + 1 < 32 // GS:
            for i in range_constexpr((gi + 1) * GS, (gi + 2) * GS):
                av[i] = vec(ldv(reads[i], 8, f16t), 8, fx.Float16)
        if gi < 3:
            store_code(c, nb1, gi, ld_cur[3 * gi: 3 * gi + 3])
        for i in range_constexpr(gi * GS, (gi + 1) * GS):
            acc = vec(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_f16(acc_ty, [av[i], qv[i % 16], acc]), 4, fx.Float32)
            if i % 16 == 15:
                sacc.append(acc)
                acc = s.zero4
    sv = []
    for kb in range_constexpr(2):
        mk = vec(ldv(c.maskp + ((t % RING) * TILE + kb * 16 + s.g4 * 4), 4, f32), 4, fx.Float32)
        for j in range_constexpr(4):
            sv.append(sacc[kb][j] * s.scale + mk[j])
    lim = m_ref + 8.0
    need = sv[0] > lim
    for j in range_constexpr(1, 8):
        need = need | (sv[j] > lim)
    anyneed = fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(A.IntegerType.get_signless(64), need)) != 0
    return ldn, sv, anyneed


def s_rescale(c, s, t, sv, m_ref):
    """the slow path: a new running max for the wave's heads; alpha to LDS for the PV-waves"""
    mx = sv[0]
    for j in range_constexpr(1, 8):
        mx = fmax(mx, sv[j])
    m_new = fmax(m_ref, grp_max(mx))
    alpha = exp2(m_ref - m_new)
    (c.alp + ((t % 2) * 64 + s.hw * 16 + s.i16)).store(alpha)
    return m_new, alpha


def s_step_b(c, s, t, sv, m_ref, l_acc):
    """S-wave step t, part 2: P = 2^(s - m) as f16 to LDS"""
    pv = [exp2(sv[j] - m_ref) for j in range(8)]
    ps = pv[0]
    for j in range_constexpr(1, 8):
        ps = ps + pv[j]
    pai = fx.Vector.from_elements(pv, fx.Float32).to(fx.Float16).bitcast(fx.Int32)
    prow = c.pbp + ((t % 2) * PSLOT + (s.hw * 16 + s.i16) * PROW + s.g4 * 8) // 4
    for kb in range_constexpr(2):
        stv(prow + kb * 8, fx.Vector.from_elements([pai[2 * kb], pai[2 * kb + 1]], fx.Int32), 8)
    return l_acc + ps


def load_q(s, Qb, g):
    """Q of group g's heads 16 hw + i16 as the B operand (f16): step st, lane group g4 holds the 16-byte chunk
    16 (st // 4) + 4 g4 + st % 4 of d (the K reads use the same chunks: conflict-free with the row swizzle)"""
    b = fx.max(g, 0) // s.HG
    h = (fx.max(g, 0) % s.HG) * 64 + s.hw * 16 + s.i16
    qrow = (b * s.HEADS + h) * D + s.g4 * 32
    return [vec(ldv(Qb + (qrow + (st // 4) * 128 + (st % 4) * 8), 8, A.BF16Type.get()), 8, fx.BFloat16)
            .to(fx.Float32).to(fx.Float16) for st in range(16)]


def pv_flag(c, p, t):
    slot = (t + 1) % 2
    return (c.flp + (slot * 4 + p.hh * 2)).load() | (c.flp + (slot * 4 + p.hh * 2 + 1)).load()


def pv_rescale(c, p, t, o):
    slot = (t + 1) % 2
    alv = [vec(ldv(c.alp + (slot * 64 + p.hh * 32 + a * 8 + p.lg * 4), 4, A.F32Type.get()), 4, fx.Float32)
           for a in range(4)]
    return [fx.Vector.from_elements([oo[k] * alv[k // 4][k % 4] for k in range(16)], fx.Float32) for oo in o]


def pv_mma(c, p, t, o, ld_cur):
    """PV-wave step t: loads of tile t + 2, O += P V for tile t - 1 (+ dequantize tile t + 1 from ld_cur)"""
    ldn = load_rope(c, t + 2, 0) + load_code(c, t + 2, 1)
    nb1 = (t + 1) % 3
    slot = (t + 1) % 2
    acc_ty = vty(16, A.F32Type.get())
    i16t = vty(4, A.IntegerType.get_signless(16))
    prow = c.pbp + (slot * PSLOT + (p.hh * 32 + p.l32) * PROW + p.lg * 16) // 4
    pa = [vec(ldv(prow + ks * 8, 8, A.F16Type.get()), 8, fx.Float16) for ks in range(2)]
    vbase = c.kt + ((t + 2) % 3) * (KBUF // 4)
    reads = []
    for db in range_constexpr(8):
        for ks in range_constexpr(2):
            for r in range_constexpr(2):
                reads.append(vbase + (p.voff[(db % 4) * 2 + r] + ks * 4096 + (db // 4) * 64))

    def tr(i):
        return vec(rocdl.ds_read_tr16_b64(i16t, fx.to_llvm_ptr(reads[i])).result, 4, fx.Int16)

    rv = [None] * 32
    for i in range_constexpr(8):
        rv[i] = tr(i)
    newo = []
    for db in range_constexpr(8):
        if db + 2 < 8:
            for i in range_constexpr((db + 2) * 4, (db + 3) * 4):
                rv[i] = tr(i)
        if db == 2:
            store_rope(c, nb1, 0, ld_cur[0:1])
        if db == 5:
            store_code(c, nb1, 1, ld_cur[1:4], c.code_ok)
        acc = o[db]
        for ks in range_constexpr(2):
            i = db * 4 + ks * 2
            bv = fx.Vector.from_elements([rv[i][0], rv[i][1], rv[i][2], rv[i][3], rv[i + 1][0], rv[i + 1][1],
                                          rv[i + 1][2], rv[i + 1][3]], fx.Int16).bitcast(fx.Float16)
            acc = vec(rocdl.mfma_f32_32x32x16_f16(acc_ty, [pa[ks], bv, acc]), 16, fx.Float32)
        newo.append(acc)
    return newo, ldn


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- attention kernel

@flyc.kernel
def attn_kernel(Q: fx.Tensor, SWA: fx.Tensor, SWI: fx.Tensor, SWL: fx.Tensor, KV: fx.Tensor, KVI: fx.Tensor,
                KVL: fx.Tensor, ZROW: fx.Tensor, PO: fx.Tensor, PML: fx.Tensor, META: fx.Tensor, scale: fx.Float32,
                HG: fx.Constexpr[int], G: fx.Constexpr[int], NREQ: fx.Constexpr[int], HEADS: fx.Constexpr[int],
                SWW: fx.Constexpr[int], KVW: fx.Constexpr[int], RS: fx.Constexpr[int], PBS: fx.Constexpr[int],
                RK: fx.Constexpr[int], PBK: fx.Constexpr[int]):
    tid = fx.thread_idx.x
    wgid = fx.block_idx.x
    wave = tid // 64
    lane = tid % 64

    @fx.struct
    class Smem:
        kt: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 3 * KBUF // 4 + 256, 16]
        pbuf: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * PSLOT // 4, 16]
        alph: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 2 * 64, 16]
        flag: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * 4, 16]
        ring: fx.Array[fx.Int32, RING * TILE * 4 + 256, 16]
        tab: fx.Array[fx.Int32, TMAX * 8, 16]
        mask: fx.Array[fx.Int32, RING * TILE + 64, 16]
        glen: fx.Array[fx.Int32, GMAX, 16]
        swlen: fx.Array[fx.Int32, GMAX, 16]
        segs: fx.Array[fx.Int32, GMAX * 4 + 4, 16]
        misc: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 16, 16]
        lseg: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 128, 16]

    sm = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
    kt_p = sm.kt.ptr
    pb_p = sm.pbuf.ptr
    al_p = sm.alph.ptr
    fl_p = sm.flag.ptr
    ring_p = sm.ring.ptr
    tab_p = sm.tab.ptr
    mask_p = sm.mask.ptr
    glen_p = sm.glen.ptr
    swl_p = sm.swlen.ptr
    seg_p = sm.segs.ptr
    misc_p = sm.misc.ptr
    lseg_p = sm.lseg.ptr

    # this workgroup's zero row, read for invalid keys: codes 0, scale bytes 7 -> +0 (the scratch holds garbage)
    zrow = fx.get_iter(ZROW) + wgid * 256
    if tid < 37:
        sw7 = (tid == 36).select(fx.Int32(0x07070707), fx.Int32(0))
        stv(zrow + tid * 4, fx.Vector.from_elements([sw7, sw7, fx.Int32(0), fx.Int32(0)], fx.Int32))

    # ---- the work split: group lengths, their prefix, this workgroup's segments
    if tid < G:
        bq = tid // HG
        (glen_p + tid).store((fx.get_iter(SWL) + bq).load() + (fx.get_iter(KVL) + bq).load())
    if tid < NREQ:
        (swl_p + tid).store((fx.get_iter(SWL) + tid).load())
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if wave == 0:
        nl = []
        for i in range_constexpr(4):
            gi = lane * 4 + i
            nl.append((gi < G).select((glen_p + fx.min(gi, GMAX - 1)).load(), fx.Int32(0)))
        # work units: VSEG virtual units (the cost of a segment start) then the tiles, a group
        nu = [(nl[i] > 0).select((nl[i] + TILE - 1) // TILE + VSEG, fx.Int32(0)) for i in range(4)]
        ex, tot = wave_excl_scan(nu[0] + nu[1] + nu[2] + nu[3])
        per = fx.max((tot + NWG - 1) // NWG, 1)
        s0 = wgid * per
        e0 = fx.min(tot, s0 + per)
        pre = ex
        cnt = fx.Int32(0)
        fl = []
        ls_l = []
        le_l = []
        nt_l = []
        for i in range_constexpr(4):
            gi = lane * 4 + i
            t0 = pre + VSEG
            lo_t = fx.max(s0, t0)
            hi_t = fx.min(e0, pre + nu[i])
            f = (nl[i] > 0) & (lo_t < hi_t)
            fl.append(f)
            ls_l.append((lo_t - t0) * TILE)
            le_l.append(fx.min((hi_t - t0) * TILE, nl[i]))
            nt_l.append(f.select(hi_t - lo_t, fx.Int32(0)))
            if wgid == 0:
                if gi < G:
                    (fx.get_iter(META) + gi).store(t0)
                    (fx.get_iter(META) + (G + 2 + gi)).store(nu[i] - VSEG)
            pre = pre + nu[i]
            cnt = cnt + f.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
        if wgid == 0:
            if lane == 0:
                (fx.get_iter(META) + G).store(tot)
                (fx.get_iter(META) + (G + 1)).store(per)
        ntl = nt_l[0] + nt_l[1] + nt_l[2] + nt_l[3]
        pk, pkt = wave_excl_scan((cnt << 16) | ntl)       # both prefixes in one scan (each < 2^16)
        pos = pk >> 16
        nseg = pkt >> 16
        tpos = pk & 0xFFFF
        ntot = pkt & 0xFFFF
        for i in range_constexpr(4):
            # (a dummy entry past the table for a group without a segment here)
            stv(seg_p + fl[i].select(pos, fx.Int32(GMAX)) * 4,
                fx.Vector.from_elements([lane * 4 + i, ls_l[i], le_l[i], tpos], fx.Int32))
            pos = pos + fl[i].select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
            tpos = tpos + nt_l[i]
        if lane == 0:
            (misc_p + 0).store(nseg)
            (misc_p + 1).store(ntot)
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    nseg = (misc_p + 0).load()
    ntot = (misc_p + 1).load()
    for jt in range_constexpr((TMAX + NTHR - 1) // NTHR):
        ti = tid + jt * NTHR
        # the tile's segment: the last one starting at or before it (one round of compares for up to 8 segments)
        lo_s = fx.Int32(0)
        for si in range_constexpr(1, 8):
            lo_s = lo_s + ((si < nseg) & ((seg_p + (si * 4 + 3)).load() <= ti)).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
        if nseg > 8:
            lo_s = fx.Int32(0)
            hi_s = fx.max(nseg, 1)
            for it in range_constexpr(8):
                mid = (lo_s + hi_s) // 2
                okm = (seg_p + (fx.min(mid, GMAX - 1) * 4 + 3)).load() <= ti
                okm = okm & (mid < hi_s) & (mid > lo_s)
                lo_s = okm.select(mid, lo_s)
                hi_s = (okm | (mid <= lo_s)).select(hi_s, mid)
        se = vec(ldv(seg_p + fx.min(lo_s, GMAX - 1) * 4, 4, i32t()), 4, fx.Int32)
        live = ti < ntot
        key0 = se[1] + (ti - se[3]) * TILE
        cnt = live.select(fx.min(se[2] - key0, fx.Int32(TILE)), fx.Int32(0))
        gq = live.select(se[0], fx.Int32(-1))
        bq = fx.max(gq, 0) // HG
        frs = (live & (ti == se[3])).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
        lst = (live & (key0 + TILE >= se[2])).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
        if ti < TMAX:
            stv(tab_p + ti * 8, fx.Vector.from_elements([gq, key0, cnt, frs], fx.Int32))
            stv(tab_p + (ti * 8 + 4), fx.Vector.from_elements([lst, wgid + fx.max(gq, 0), (swl_p + bq).load(), bq],
                                                              fx.Int32))
    fx.gpu.barrier()
    if ntot > 0:
        npairs = (ntot + 2) // 2            # steps 0 .. ntot (+ one spare), two a loop trip
        c = Ctx()
        c.kt, c.pbp, c.alp, c.flp, c.ringp, c.tabp, c.maskp = kt_p, pb_p, al_p, fl_p, ring_p, tab_p, mask_p
        c.gspace = fx.get_iter(SWA).memspace
        c.swa_b = addr_of(SWA)
        c.kv_b = addr_of(KV)
        c.zero_b = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(zrow))
        c.swi_b = addr_of(SWI)
        c.kvi_b = addr_of(KVI)
        c.SWW, c.KVW, c.RS, c.PBS, c.RK, c.PBK = SWW, KVW, RS, PBS, RK, PBK
        c.lane = lane
        # ---- row addresses of tiles 0 .. 3; tile 4's indices in flight
        pend = [prod_load(c, fx.Int32(i), lane) for i in range(5)]
        if wave == 7:
            for i in range_constexpr(4):
                prod_store(c, fx.Int32(i), pend[i][0], pend[i][1], lane)
        # zero K buffer 2, P buffer 1, the flags: the PV-waves' first step works on them
        zi = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Int32(0)] * 4, fx.Int32)
        for zz in range_constexpr(4):
            stv(kt_p + (2 * (KBUF // 4) + (zz * NTHR + tid) * 4), zi)
        if tid < PSLOT // 16:
            stv(pb_p + (PSLOT // 4 + tid * 4), zi)
        if tid < 8:
            (fl_p + tid).store(fx.Int32(0))
        fx.gpu.barrier()
        zero4 = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Float32(0.0)] * 4, fx.Float32)
        if wave < 4:
            # ================= S-waves
            chunk_setup_s(c, tid)
            g4 = lane // 16
            i16 = lane % 16
            s = Ctx()
            s.g4, s.i16, s.hw, s.zero4, s.scale, s.HG, s.HEADS = g4, i16, wave, zero4, scale, HG, HEADS
            swk = swz(i16)
            s.koff = [i16 * 256 + ((g4 * 4 + s4) ^ swk) * 4 for s4 in range(4)]
            qb = fx.get_iter(Q)
            ld0 = []
            lda = []
            for r in range_constexpr(3):
                ld0.extend(load_code(c, fx.Int32(0), r))
            for r in range_constexpr(3):
                lda.extend(load_code(c, fx.Int32(1), r))
            for r in range_constexpr(3):
                store_code(c, fx.Int32(0), r, ld0[3 * r: 3 * r + 3])
            fx.gpu.barrier()
            zq = zero4.bitcast(fx.Float16)
            qv = [zq for _ in range(16)]
            m_ref = fx.Float32(-1e30)
            l_acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
            pml_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(fx.get_iter(PML)))
            for tp in range(npairs):
                ta = tp * 2
                mt, mth = tile_info(c, ta)
                if mt[3] != 0:
                    qv = load_q(s, qb, mt[0])
                    m_ref = fx.Float32(-1e30)
                    l_acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
                ldb, sva, nda = s_step_a(c, s, ta, lda, qv, m_ref)
                fls = (fl_p + ((ta % 2) * 4 + wave))
                if nda:
                    fls.store(fx.Int32(1))
                    m_ref, alpha = s_rescale(c, s, ta, sva, m_ref)
                    l_acc = l_acc * alpha
                else:
                    fls.store(fx.Int32(0))
                    (al_p + ((ta % 2) * 64 + wave * 16 + i16)).store(fx.Float32(1.0))
                l_acc = s_step_b(c, s, ta, sva, m_ref, l_acc)
                if mth[0] != 0:
                    lt = grp_sum(l_acc)
                    (lseg_p + ((ta % 2) * 64 + wave * 16 + i16)).store(lt)
                    if g4 == 0:
                        hh = (wave * 16 + i16) * NSLOT + mth[1]
                        wt_store(pml_rs, hh, m_ref, 4)
                        wt_store(pml_rs, 64 * NSLOT + hh, lt, 4)
                fx.gpu.barrier()
                tb = tp * 2 + 1
                mu, muh = tile_info(c, tb)
                if mu[3] != 0:
                    qv = load_q(s, qb, mu[0])
                    m_ref = fx.Float32(-1e30)
                    l_acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
                lda, svb, ndb = s_step_a(c, s, tb, ldb, qv, m_ref)
                flt = (fl_p + ((tb % 2) * 4 + wave))
                if ndb:
                    flt.store(fx.Int32(1))
                    m_ref, alpha2 = s_rescale(c, s, tb, svb, m_ref)
                    l_acc = l_acc * alpha2
                else:
                    flt.store(fx.Int32(0))
                    (al_p + ((tb % 2) * 64 + wave * 16 + i16)).store(fx.Float32(1.0))
                l_acc = s_step_b(c, s, tb, svb, m_ref, l_acc)
                if muh[0] != 0:
                    lt2 = grp_sum(l_acc)
                    (lseg_p + ((tb % 2) * 64 + wave * 16 + i16)).store(lt2)
                    if g4 == 0:
                        hh2 = (wave * 16 + i16) * NSLOT + muh[1]
                        wt_store(pml_rs, hh2, m_ref, 4)
                        wt_store(pml_rs, 64 * NSLOT + hh2, lt2, 4)
                fx.gpu.barrier()
        else:
            # ================= PV-waves: heads 32 hh .. +32, dims 256 dd .. +256
            ptid = tid - 256
            chunk_setup_pv(c, ptid)
            pw = wave - 4
            p = Ctx()
            p.hh = pw // 2
            dd = pw % 2
            p.l32 = lane % 32
            p.lg = lane // 32
            gq = lane // 16
            sq = lane % 16
            p.voff = []
            for db4 in range_constexpr(4):
                for r in range_constexpr(2):
                    row = 8 * (gq // 2) + 4 * r + sq // 4
                    chunk = dd * 32 + db4 * 4 + 2 * (gq % 2) + (sq % 4) // 2
                    p.voff.append(row * 256 + (chunk ^ swz(row)) * 4 + (sq % 2) * 2)
            ld0 = load_rope(c, fx.Int32(0), 0) + load_code(c, fx.Int32(0), 1)
            lda = load_rope(c, fx.Int32(1), 0) + load_code(c, fx.Int32(1), 1)
            store_rope(c, fx.Int32(0), 0, ld0[0:1])
            store_code(c, fx.Int32(0), 1, ld0[1:4], c.code_ok)
            fx.gpu.barrier()
            zero16 = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Float32(0.0)] * 16, fx.Float32)
            o = [zero16 for _ in range(8)]
            pidx, pflg = pend[4][0], pend[4][1]
            po_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(fx.get_iter(PO)))
            for tp in range(npairs):
                for half in range_constexpr(2):
                    t = tp * 2 + half
                    if wave == 7:
                        prod_store(c, t + 4, pidx, pflg, lane)
                        pidx, pflg = prod_load(c, t + 5, lane)
                    mt, mth = tile_info(c, fx.max(t - 1, 0))
                    mtl = (t > 0).select(mth[0], fx.Int32(0))
                    fla = pv_flag(c, p, t)
                    if fla != 0:
                        o = pv_rescale(c, p, t, o)
                    o, lda = pv_mma(c, p, t, o, lda)
                    if mtl != 0:
                        # the segment's last tile: O / l (f16) to its slot
                        lsv = [vec(ldv(lseg_p + (((t + 1) % 2) * 64 + p.hh * 32 + a4 * 8 + p.lg * 4), 4,
                                       A.F32Type.get()), 4, fx.Float32) for a4 in range(4)]
                        inv = [(lsv[k // 4][k % 4] > 0.0).select(1.0 / lsv[k // 4][k % 4], fx.Float32(0.0))
                               for k in range(16)]
                        for db in range_constexpr(8):
                            for k in range_constexpr(16):
                                hq = mth[1] * 64 + p.hh * 32 + (k // 4) * 8 + p.lg * 4 + k % 4
                                wt_store(po_rs, hq * D + dd * 256 + db * 32 + p.l32, (o[db][k] * inv[k]).to(fx.Float16),
                                         2)
                    fx.gpu.barrier()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- combine kernel

@flyc.kernel
def combine_kernel(PO: fx.Tensor, PML: fx.Tensor, META: fx.Tensor, SINK: fx.Tensor, OUT: fx.Tensor,
                   LSE: fx.Tensor, kv_scale: fx.Float32,
                   HG: fx.Constexpr[int], G: fx.Constexpr[int], HEADS: fx.Constexpr[int]):
    """a wave a (request, head): lane i holds slot w0 + i's (m, l); 8 output dims a lane"""
    tid = fx.thread_idx.x % 64
    row = fx.block_idx.x * CRW + fx.thread_idx.x // 64            # b * HEADS + h
    b = row // HEADS
    h = row % HEADS
    grp = b * HG + h // 64
    hh = h % 64
    meta = fx.get_iter(META)
    p0 = (meta + grp).load()
    ng = (meta + (G + 2 + grp)).load()
    per = (meta + (G + 1)).load()
    w0 = p0 // per
    w1 = (p0 + fx.max(ng, 1) - 1) // per + 1
    nsl = (ng > 0).select(w1 - w0, fx.Int32(0))
    pml = fx.get_iter(PML)
    po = fx.get_iter(PO)
    f32 = A.F32Type.get()
    s0 = hh * NSLOT + w0 + grp
    acc = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Float32(0.0)] * 8, fx.Float32)
    mm = fx.Float32(-1e30)
    lsum = fx.Float32(0.0)
    for c0 in range(0, nsl, 64):
        live = tid + c0 < nsl
        mi = live.select((pml + (s0 + c0 + fx.min(tid, nsl - c0 - 1))).load(), fx.Float32(-1e30))
        li = live.select((pml + (64 * NSLOT + s0 + c0 + fx.min(tid, nsl - c0 - 1))).load(), fx.Float32(0.0))
        mx = mi
        for sh in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
            mx = fmax(mx, fx.Float32(fx.gpu.shuffle_xor(mx, sh, 64)))
        m_new = fmax(mm, mx)
        sc = exp2(mm - m_new)
        acc = acc * sc
        wi = li * exp2(mi - m_new)
        ws = wi
        for sh in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
            ws = ws + fx.Float32(fx.gpu.shuffle_xor(ws, sh, 64))
        lsum = lsum * sc + ws
        mm = m_new
        nn = fx.min(nsl - c0, 64)
        for i in range(0, nn, 8):
            ovs = []
            wvs = []
            for u in range_constexpr(8):
                iu = fx.min(i + u, nn - 1)
                wvs.append((i + u < nn).select(fx.Float32(rocdl.readlane(f32, wi.ir_value(), iu)), fx.Float32(0.0)))
                base = (w0 + c0 + iu + grp) * 64 + hh
                ovs.append(vec(ldv(po + (base * D + tid * 8), 8, A.F16Type.get()), 8, fx.Float16))
            for u in range_constexpr(8):
                acc = acc + ovs[u].to(fx.Float32) * wvs[u]
    sink = (fx.get_iter(SINK) + h).load()
    den = lsum + exp2(sink * LOG2E - mm)
    has = lsum > 0.0
    inv = has.select(kv_scale / den, fx.Float32(0.0))
    stv(fx.get_iter(OUT) + (row * D + tid * 8), (acc * inv).to(fx.BFloat16))
    if tid == 0:
        lg = fx.Float32(rocdl.log(f32, fx.maxnumf(lsum, fx.Float32(1e-30)).ir_value()))
        (fx.get_iter(LSE) + row).store(has.select((lg + mm) * LN2, fx.Float32(math.inf)))


@flyc.jit
def _launch(Q: fx.Tensor, SWA: fx.Tensor, SWI: fx.Tensor, SWL: fx.Tensor, KV: fx.Tensor, KVI: fx.Tensor,
            KVL: fx.Tensor, ZROW: fx.Tensor, PO: fx.Tensor, PML: fx.Tensor, META: fx.Tensor, SINK: fx.Tensor,
            OUT: fx.Tensor, LSE: fx.Tensor, scale: fx.Float32, kv_scale: fx.Float32,
            HG: fx.Constexpr[int], G: fx.Constexpr[int], NREQ: fx.Constexpr[int], HEADS: fx.Constexpr[int],
            SWW: fx.Constexpr[int], KVW: fx.Constexpr[int], RS: fx.Constexpr[int], PBS: fx.Constexpr[int],
            RK: fx.Constexpr[int], PBK: fx.Constexpr[int], stream: fx.Stream = fx.Stream(None)):
    attn_kernel(Q, SWA, SWI, SWL, KV, KVI, KVL, ZROW, PO, PML, META, scale, HG, G, NREQ, HEADS,
                SWW, KVW, RS, PBS, RK, PBK).launch(grid=(NWG, 1, 1), block=(NTHR, 1, 1), stream=stream)
    combine_kernel(PO, PML, META, SINK, OUT, LSE, kv_scale, HG, G, HEADS).launch(
        grid=(NREQ * HEADS // CRW, 1, 1), block=(64 * CRW, 1, 1), stream=stream)


@functools.cache
def _config(B, H, sww, kvw, rs, pbs, rk, pbk):
    """the compiled launcher for a shape (FlyDSL specializes on the constexpr arguments at its first call)"""
    if H % 64 or B * H // 64 > GMAX or B > GMAX:
        raise NotImplementedError(f"heads {H} (a multiple of 64), batch {B} (groups <= {GMAX})")
    if (sww + kvw + TILE - 1) // TILE + VSEG > TMAX - 8:
        raise NotImplementedError(f"key lists of {sww} + {kvw} entries are longer than a workgroup's tile table")
    fn = flyc.compile[{"waves_per_eu": 2}](_launch)
    consts = (H // 64, B * H // 64, B, H, sww, kvw, rs, pbs, rk, pbk)
    return fn, consts


def _pool(t):
    """(byte view [pages][page bytes], rows a page, page bytes) of a [pages][page_rows][1][584] fp8 pool view: a page
    holds its rows' 576 data bytes back to back, then their 8 scale bytes each (the view's inner strides are nominal)"""
    if t.dim() != 4 or t.shape[2] != 1 or t.shape[3] != 584 or t.element_size() != 1:
        raise NotImplementedError("pools must be fp8 padded-page views [pages][page_rows][1][584]")
    pages, rows, pb = t.shape[0], t.shape[1], t.stride(0)
    if pb < rows * 584:
        raise NotImplementedError("a page's stride is smaller than its rows")
    return t.view(torch.uint8).as_strided((pages, pb), (pb, 1)), rows, pb


def run(*, q, kv_cache, sparse_indices, sparse_lens, extra_kv_cache, extra_sparse_indices, extra_sparse_lens,
        block_table=None, cache_seqlens=None, cu_seqlens_k=None, causal=False, head_dim_v=D, sm_scale=None,
        sinks=None, kv_cache_format="dsv4_fp8", kv_scale=1.0, return_lse=True, kv_cache_layout="padded_pages",
        output=None, lse=None):
    """The AKLR entry: q [B][1][H][512] bf16; pools fp8 [pages][page_rows][1][584] (padded pages); sparse indices
    [B][1][W] int32 (-1: no entry), lens [B]; sinks [H] f32. Writes output [B][1][H][512] bf16 and lse [B][1][H]."""
    if (block_table is not None or cache_seqlens is not None or cu_seqlens_k is not None or causal
            or head_dim_v != D or kv_cache_format != "dsv4_fp8" or kv_cache_layout != "padded_pages"
            or sinks is None or output is None):
        raise NotImplementedError("dsv4_fp8 padded-page sparse decode with sinks only")
    B, sq, H, d = q.shape
    if sq != 1 or d != D:
        raise NotImplementedError("decode (one query token) with 512-dim heads only")
    for t in (q, sparse_indices, sparse_lens, extra_sparse_indices, extra_sparse_lens, sinks, output):
        if not t.is_contiguous():
            raise NotImplementedError("contiguous q / indices / lens / sinks / output only")
    swa, rs, pbs = _pool(kv_cache)
    kv, rk, pbk = _pool(extra_kv_cache)
    sww = sparse_indices.shape[-1]
    kvw = extra_sparse_indices.shape[-1]
    fn, consts = _config(B, H, sww, kvw, rs, pbs, rk, pbk)
    G = consts[1]
    dev = q.device
    if lse is None or not return_lse:
        lse = torch.empty((B, 1, H), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
    zrow = torch.empty(NWG * 256, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
    po = torch.empty((NWG + G) * 64 * D, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    pml = torch.empty(NSLOT * 64 * 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
    meta = torch.empty(2 * G + 2, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
    fn(q, swa, sparse_indices, sparse_lens, kv, extra_sparse_indices, extra_sparse_lens, zrow, po, pml, meta, sinks,
       output, lse, float(sm_scale) * float(kv_scale) * LOG2E, float(kv_scale), *consts,
       stream=fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(dev)))
